title: Tech Note: Idle User Detective
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates a classic-language technique for monitoring user inactivity and programmatically disconnecting idle Remote (Client) connections, using an internal 4D method loop plus OS-specific external calls for true system idle-time detection. The core approach (background process polling, countdown dialog, forced disconnect) still works unchanged in current 4D versions since it relies on stable, backward-compatible commands, so it remains a valid, still-relevant pattern for client/server deployments that need to reclaim idle licenses today.
